Frozen 156 storySeeds and emotionIds mappings untouched. Schema migration (step 4) still pending.

emotions.label: Frustrated
emotions.definition: Something isn't going their way right now and they want to react immediately.

emotions.label: Angry
emotions.definition: Feels wronged or treated unfairly and wants to push back.

emotions.label: Scared
emotions.definition: Something feels frightening, right now.

emotions.label: Worried
emotions.definition: Something might go wrong — anticipating a bad outcome that hasn't happened yet.

emotions.label: Sad
emotions.definition: Feeling down about a loss, disappointment, or ending.

emotions.label: Missing Someone
emotions.definition: Grief or longing for a person, pet, or connection that's gone or far away.

emotions.label: Embarrassed
emotions.definition: Self-conscious after a public or exposed moment.

emotions.label: Not Good Enough
emotions.definition: Shame or self-doubt about their own worth or ability.

emotions.label: Jealous
emotions.definition: Wanting what someone else has.

emotions.label: Left Out
emotions.definition: Excluded from a group, game, or connection.

emotions.label: Overwhelmed
emotions.definition: Too much happening at once — sensory or mental overload.

emotions.label: Bored
emotions.definition: Nothing to do, low stimulation, hard to settle.

emotions.label: Tired or Cranky
emotions.definition: Body-state driven irritability — hunger, tiredness, overstimulation.

emotions.label: Nervous
emotions.definition: Something important is about to happen — anticipating a performance, test, or unfamiliar event.

emotions.label: Guilty
emotions.definition: Feels bad about something they did or didn't do.

emotions.label: Confused About Right and Wrong
emotions.definition: Facing a moral dilemma with no clear answer.

emotions.label: Disappointed
emotions.definition: An expectation or plan didn't come through.

emotions.label: Unsure
emotions.definition: Facing something new or unfamiliar and not sure how to act.

emotions.label: Comparing Themselves to Others
emotions.definition: Measuring their own worth, looks, or things against someone else's.

emotions.label: Torn Between Two Choices
emotions.definition: Caught between two people, loyalties, or choices.

situations.title: Toy not shared or taken away
situations.parentLabel: Someone won't share the toy you're playing with

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is playing with a favourite toy when another child picks it up and walks away with it.
storySeed.immediateWant: Get the toy back.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The other child is already playing with it and doesn't realize Kavi was using it.
storySeed.emotionalTension: It feels unfair, and Kavi wants to grab it back immediately.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi is happily playing when another child picks up the toy and walks away. Kavi wants it back right now, and every part of Kavi says, 'That's mine!'

situations.title: Screen time cut off suddenly
situations.parentLabel: Screen time ended before you were ready

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is in the middle of an exciting game when a parent says screen time is over.
storySeed.immediateWant: Keep playing until the game is finished.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The agreed screen-time limit has ended.
storySeed.emotionalTension: The ending feels sudden and unfair because Kavi is having fun.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi is deep into a game when the screen suddenly goes dark. Kavi isn't ready to stop—not even close.

situations.title: Told 'no' without explanation
situations.parentLabel: Told 'no' without an explanation

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi asks to do something they really want to do, and a parent simply says no.
storySeed.immediateWant: Understand why they cannot do it.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The adult does not give an explanation.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wonders whether the 'no' means the adult doesn't care.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi asks for something that matters and hears a simple, 'No.' Kavi wants to know why, but no explanation comes.

situations.title: Sibling gets a bigger portion
situations.parentLabel: A sibling got a bigger portion

storySeed.childExperience: At snack time, Kavi notices that a sibling has been given a bigger or more appealing portion.
storySeed.immediateWant: Have the same amount.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The sibling's portion is already theirs.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels smaller and less important.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi looks at the two plates and immediately notices the difference. It feels as though the bigger portion somehow means bigger love.

situations.title: Can't finish homework
situations.parentLabel: Couldn't finish your homework

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is working on a difficult homework task and cannot get the answer right.
storySeed.immediateWant: Finish the problem successfully.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The answer keeps coming out wrong despite trying.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Each failed attempt makes Kavi wonder whether they simply can't do it.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi has been staring at the same homework problem for what feels like forever. Every answer seems wrong, and frustration is growing.

situations.title: Playdate or plan suddenly cancelled
situations.parentLabel: A playdate was suddenly cancelled

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is ready for a playdate when they learn the friend cannot come.
storySeed.immediateWant: Have the playtime that was planned.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The friend has cancelled and the plan cannot happen.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels the excitement disappear all at once.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi has everything ready for the playdate when the news arrives: the friend isn't coming.

situations.title: Someone breaks their Lego or drawing
situations.parentLabel: Someone broke something you built

storySeed.childExperience: Another child accidentally breaks Kavi's Lego creation while playing nearby.
storySeed.immediateWant: Save or rebuild the creation.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The creation has fallen apart and cannot simply be put back as it was.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels angry because something made with care has been destroyed.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi has just finished building something special when it crashes apart. For one hot second, all Kavi wants to do is shout.

situations.title: Being hurried to put shoes on or leave
situations.parentLabel: Being rushed to leave the house

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is getting ready to leave but hasn't finished putting on shoes and gathering their things.
storySeed.immediateWant: Finish getting ready at their own pace.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The family needs to leave now.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Being hurried makes everything feel harder.
context: home, before school or an outing
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi is still searching for one shoe when someone calls, 'We're leaving!' Suddenly everything has to happen at once.

situations.title: Feeling hungry or extremely tired (hangry)
situations.parentLabel: Hungry and tired all at once

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi has gone too long without food or rest and becomes unusually cranky over a small problem.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel comfortable again.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Hunger or tiredness is making ordinary things feel much harder.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels overwhelmed without realizing how much the body is affecting the mood.
context: late afternoon, after a busy stretch
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Everything seems annoying. The noise is too loud, the little problem feels enormous, and Kavi doesn't realize yet that the real trouble may be a tired, hungry body.

situations.title: Blamed for something they didn't do
situations.parentLabel: Blamed for something you didn't do

storySeed.childExperience: Something goes wrong at home or school and everyone assumes Kavi caused it.
storySeed.immediateWant: Make someone understand what really happened.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Nobody has heard Kavi's side yet.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Being blamed feels like nobody believes Kavi.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Something has gone wrong, and suddenly everyone is looking at Kavi. But Kavi knows one thing for sure: I didn't do it.

situations.title: Being pushed during a disagreement
situations.parentLabel: Pushed by another child during play

storySeed.childExperience: Another child pushes Kavi during a disagreement over a game.
storySeed.immediateWant: Stay safe and make the unfairness stop.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi is hurt and angry, and pushing back could make the situation worse.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels hurt, angry and ready to retaliate.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The game stops when another child gives Kavi a hard push. Kavi's eyes sting, fists tighten, and one thought arrives immediately: Push back.

situations.title: No say in what to wear
situations.parentLabel: No say in what you had to wear

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi wants to wear a favourite outfit, but a parent says they must wear something else.
storySeed.immediateWant: Choose their own clothes.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The parent has already decided what is appropriate for the day.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels they have no say in something that feels personal.
context: getting dressed before school or an outing
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi has already picked the perfect outfit. Then a parent appears with a completely different one.

situations.title: Adult doesn't understand what they mean
situations.parentLabel: An adult didn't understand what you meant

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi explains something important to a parent, but the parent misunderstands.
storySeed.immediateWant: Be understood.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi's explanation isn't getting through.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi starts wondering whether something is wrong with the way they communicate.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: 'That's not what I meant!' Kavi tries again. But somehow the words keep landing differently from what Kavi intended.

situations.title: Game crashes or internet lags during a win
situations.parentLabel: The game froze right before winning

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is about to win a game when the game freezes.
storySeed.immediateWant: Finish the game and keep the progress.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The screen stops responding.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Hours of effort suddenly feel as though they might disappear.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi is one move away from winning when the screen freezes. Kavi stares at it, hoping the game will somehow wake up.

situations.title: Forced to sit still too long (car, flight)
situations.parentLabel: Forced to sit still for a long time

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is travelling in a car or plane and has been sitting for a long time.
storySeed.immediateWant: Move, stretch or find something to do.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: They cannot freely move around yet.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Restlessness builds until even small things become irritating.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi shifts once. Then twice. Then for the tenth time. The journey suddenly feels much longer than it did at the beginning.

situations.title: Game save file corrupted or deleted
situations.parentLabel: A saved game was lost

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi opens a favourite game and discovers that their saved progress is gone.
storySeed.immediateWant: Get the lost progress back.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The saved game cannot be restored.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Losing hours of effort feels like losing something they built.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi opens the game expecting to continue exactly where they stopped. Instead, the screen shows the beginning.

situations.title: A treat or promise was forgotten
situations.parentLabel: A promised treat was forgotten

storySeed.childExperience: A parent had promised Kavi a special treat, but later seems to have forgotten.
storySeed.immediateWant: Have the promised treat—or understand what happened.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The promise has slipped the adult's mind.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wonders whether the forgotten promise means it wasn't important.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi has been remembering the promise all day. But when the moment arrives, the grown-up seems to have forgotten completely.

situations.title: Sibling tells on them unfairly
situations.parentLabel: A sibling told on you unfairly

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi's sibling tells a parent about something Kavi did but leaves out an important part.
storySeed.immediateWant: Explain what really happened.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The sibling's version is already being believed.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wants to get even because the story feels unfair.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: 'Kavi did it!' comes from the other room. Kavi knows that's not the whole story—but shouting louder won't necessarily make it fairer.

situations.title: Scratchy clothes
situations.parentLabel: Your clothes felt scratchy and uncomfortable

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is wearing a shirt that feels scratchy and irritating.
storySeed.immediateWant: Get comfortable.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The uncomfortable clothing keeps distracting Kavi.
storySeed.emotionalTension: The irritation grows until ordinary things start feeling unbearable.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The shirt is scratchy. Kavi tries to ignore it. Then tries again. Soon even a tiny question feels much too annoying.

situations.title: Repeatedly failing a game level
situations.parentLabel: Kept failing the same game level

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi has tried the same game level several times and keeps failing at the same point.
storySeed.immediateWant: Beat the level.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The same difficult section keeps defeating Kavi.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Repeated failure makes quitting feel easier than trying again.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi reaches the same tricky part again. And again. And again. Each time the level wins, and Kavi starts wondering whether it is time to give up.

situations.title: Darkness or shadows in the room
situations.parentLabel: Scared of the dark

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi needs to cross a dark room to get something.
storySeed.immediateWant: Reach the other side and get the object.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The familiar room suddenly feels strange and scary in the darkness.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wants to stop because the fear feels like a warning.
context: home at bedtime or during a power cut
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi knows exactly where the toy is. But when the lights go out, the same room suddenly feels like a completely different place.

situations.title: Thunder
situations.parentLabel: Startled by thunder

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is startled by an unexpected burst of thunder.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel safe and make the frightening sound stop.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The sound is outside Kavi's control and may happen again.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Each rumble makes Kavi's body jump before Kavi has time to think.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: BOOM! Kavi jumps. The room is safe, but Kavi's body hasn't received the message yet.

situations.title: Monsters under the bed
situations.parentLabel: Thought there was a monster under the bed

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi sees a shadow under the bed and imagines a monster hiding there.
storySeed.immediateWant: Find out whether the monster is real and feel safe enough to sleep.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi's imagination keeps turning ordinary shadows into frightening shapes.
storySeed.emotionalTension: The more Kavi imagines, the more real the fear feels.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi sees something moving beneath the bed. Or at least it looks like it is moving. Suddenly every shadow has teeth.

situations.title: Parent leaving for a long trip
situations.parentLabel: A parent leaving for a long trip

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi watches a parent pack for a work trip and knows they will be away for several days.
storySeed.immediateWant: Keep the parent from leaving or make sure they come back.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The parent has to leave.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Goodbye feels much bigger when Kavi is already imagining being alone without them.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi hugs Mama tightly at the door, suitcase already by her feet. Mama will come back—but Kavi's worried heart keeps asking, 'What if this goodbye lasts forever?'

situations.title: Fear of going on stage or presenting
situations.parentLabel: Nervous before going on stage

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is waiting backstage for a school performance.
storySeed.immediateWant: Get through the performance successfully.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi is nervous and suddenly aware of everyone watching.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi believes the nervous feeling means they aren't ready.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi knows the words perfectly backstage. Then the curtain begins to open, and suddenly even standing still feels difficult.

situations.title: Anxiety before a big test or result
situations.parentLabel: Anxious before a big test

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi has finished an important test and is waiting to find out the result.
storySeed.immediateWant: Know whether the result will be good.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: There is nothing more Kavi can do to change the result.
storySeed.emotionalTension: The waiting leaves room for every possible worry.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The test is over. Kavi's pencil is down, but Kavi's mind keeps replaying every answer.

situations.title: Injections at the doctor
situations.parentLabel: Scared of getting a shot at the doctor

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is at the doctor's office and knows an injection is coming.
storySeed.immediateWant: Avoid the injection or make it hurt less.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The appointment cannot simply be skipped.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi is afraid of pain that hasn't even happened yet.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi sits on the examination chair and looks at the little tray beside the doctor. The injection hasn't happened yet—but Kavi is already imagining it.

situations.title: Unfamiliar adult
situations.parentLabel: Meeting an unfamiliar adult

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is dropped off somewhere unfamiliar and a grown-up Kavi has never met greets them and takes charge of the visit.
storySeed.immediateWant: Know whether this new adult can be trusted and feel safe.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi doesn't know this person yet, and the usual trusted adult isn't right there.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wants to be polite but also wants to stay cautious until they know more.
context: a relative's friend's home, a birthday party, a new activity drop-off
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The door opens and it isn't a face Kavi knows. 'You must be Kavi! Come on in,' the stranger says warmly. Kavi stands at the doorway a second longer than necessary.
storySeed.note: REWRITTEN — previous draft was specifically a new-teacher scene, which duplicated SIT118. This version is a genuinely unfamiliar adult outside a school context.

situations.title: Fear of getting lost in a mall or crowd
situations.parentLabel: Got separated from a parent in a crowd

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi looks up in a busy place and suddenly cannot see their parent.
storySeed.immediateWant: Find the parent.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: There are many people moving around and the familiar hand is gone.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Panic makes it harder to remember what to do.
context: mall, festival or crowded public place
storySeed.narrativeSummary: One moment Kavi is holding Mama's hand. The next, there are people everywhere—and Mama is nowhere in sight.

situations.title: Accidentally saw a scary or violent video
situations.parentLabel: Accidentally saw something scary online

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi accidentally sees a frightening video on a phone or tablet.
storySeed.immediateWant: Make the frightening image stop replaying in their mind.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The video is over, but the memory of it remains.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi begins imagining that what they saw might happen to them.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The video is gone now. But when Kavi closes their eyes, the scary picture comes back.

situations.title: Heard about war or violence on news
situations.parentLabel: Heard grown-ups talk about war on the news

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi overhears a news report about people living through war.
storySeed.immediateWant: Understand whether the family is safe.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The problem is enormous and far beyond Kavi's ability to control.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Adult-sized information creates a fear Kavi doesn't know how to hold.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi hears grown-ups talking about people far away who are in danger. The world suddenly feels much bigger—and much scarier.
storySeed.note: Keep reassurance-focused, not graphic — do not dramatize the violence.

situations.title: Saw news about floods
situations.parentLabel: Saw news about a flood

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi sees images of a flood on the television and worries that everything is ruined.
storySeed.immediateWant: Understand what happens to people after something so terrible.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi cannot fix the disaster personally.
storySeed.emotionalTension: The pictures make a distant event feel frighteningly close.
context: watching news coverage with a parent
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi sees streets covered with water on the television. It looks as if the whole world has been swept away.

situations.title: Fear that a parent might get sick
situations.parentLabel: Worried a parent might get sick

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi notices a parent feeling unwell and begins imagining something terrible happening.
storySeed.immediateWant: Make sure the parent will be okay.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi cannot know exactly what will happen.
storySeed.emotionalTension: The fear grows because Kavi keeps imagining losing someone they love.
context: home, parent has a minor illness
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Mama says she doesn't feel well and lies down. Kavi hears the words, 'I'll be fine,' but the worrying part of Kavi's mind isn't convinced.

situations.title: Overheard adults talking about money problems
situations.parentLabel: Overheard grown-ups worry about money

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi overhears parents discussing a money problem.
storySeed.immediateWant: Know whether the family will be okay.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The conversation is adult-sized and Kavi doesn't know what the words mean.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi begins filling the gaps with frightening possibilities.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi is getting a glass of water when voices drift from the next room. The grown-ups are talking about money, and suddenly Kavi wonders if everything at home is going to change.

situations.title: Overthinking imaginary future dangers
situations.parentLabel: Can't stop imagining what could go wrong

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi hears about an upcoming event and starts imagining everything that could go wrong.
storySeed.immediateWant: Make the worrying thoughts stop.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Each attempt to solve one imaginary danger creates another.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi's thoughts begin feeling like facts.
context: bedtime or a quiet moment before something important
storySeed.narrativeSummary: What if I forget? What if something goes wrong? What if…? Kavi's little 'what if' thought keeps growing until it fills the whole room.
storySeed.note: REVISED per locked decision — now has an external trigger (an upcoming event) rather than being a pure internal spiral.

situations.title: Fear of being laughed at by class
situations.parentLabel: Afraid the class will laugh at you

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi has to answer, perform or show something in front of the class.
storySeed.immediateWant: Avoid being laughed at.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi cannot control what classmates might think or say.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Imagining everyone's laughter feels worse than the actual task.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi knows the answer. Kavi even knows how to say it. But the thought of everyone laughing makes Kavi's hand stay firmly down.

situations.title: Fear of dogs
situations.parentLabel: Afraid of a dog nearby

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is walking outside when a dog approaches.
storySeed.immediateWant: Stay safe without panicking.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The dog is unfamiliar and Kavi is afraid of what it might do.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Fear says, Run! even though running may not be the safest choice.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi spots the dog before it spots Kavi. Then the dog looks up—and starts walking closer.

situations.title: Fear of falling or getting hurt at park
situations.parentLabel: Scared to try again after a fall

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi fell while playing at the park and now wants to try the same activity again.
storySeed.immediateWant: Play again without getting hurt.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The memory of the fall makes Kavi hesitate.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wants to try but worries that one fall proves they shouldn't.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi looks at the climbing frame. Yesterday, Kavi fell from it. Today, Kavi wants to climb again—but the memory of that fall is still sitting in Kavi's knees.

situations.title: Fear of getting in trouble with teacher
situations.parentLabel: Worried a teacher will be angry

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi realizes they made a mistake at school and worries the teacher will be angry.
storySeed.immediateWant: Avoid getting into trouble.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi must decide whether to hide the mistake or tell the truth.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Fear of being seen as a 'bad child' competes with the need to be honest.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi looks at the mess on the desk. Nobody has noticed yet. Kavi could quietly fix it—or pretend it never happened.

situations.title: Friend doesn't want to play today
situations.parentLabel: A friend didn't want to play with you today

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi asks a friend to play, but the friend says they don't want to play today.
storySeed.immediateWant: Play with the friend as usual.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The friend has said no, for reasons Kavi doesn't know.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels quietly hurt and confused when their friend doesn't want to play with them and gives no explanation.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi asks, the way Kavi always asks. This time the answer is 'Not today.' Kavi stands there, holding the question that has nowhere to go.
storySeed.note: REFRAMED per locked decision to differentiate from SIT082 (replacement/exclusion) — this is about missing connection/disappointment, not being displaced.

situations.title: Death of a pet
situations.parentLabel: Your pet died

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi's beloved pet has died, and the familiar pet is no longer at home.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel close to the pet again and make sense of the loss.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The pet cannot come back.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi misses the ordinary little moments that used to feel permanent.
context: home, after the death of a pet
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi still looks toward the place where the pet used to sleep. For a moment, Kavi almost expects to hear familiar paws.
storySeed.note: This is a grief story, not a lesson about moving on. Sadness should remain real while showing love can continue through memory and care.

situations.title: Death of a relative or family member
situations.parentLabel: A family member died

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi misses a grandparent or other close family member who has died.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel connected to that person.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The person cannot be physically present.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wonders whether happiness is somehow wrong when someone they love is gone.
context: family home, remembrance or an ordinary triggering moment
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Everyone is talking about Grandpa, and Kavi suddenly wishes he could walk through the door. The house is full of memories—but Grandpa isn't there.
storySeed.note: Do not force a child to 'get over' grief.

situations.title: Lost a favourite toy or comfort blanket
situations.parentLabel: Lost your favourite toy or blanket

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi discovers that a favourite toy or comfort blanket is missing.
storySeed.immediateWant: Find it.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Nobody knows where it is.
storySeed.emotionalTension: The object feels irreplaceable because it has helped Kavi feel safe for a long time.
context: home, bedtime or after returning from an outing
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Bedtime is almost here, but Kavi's favourite blanket is nowhere to be found. Suddenly the whole room feels wrong.

situations.title: Harshly reprimanded by a parent
situations.parentLabel: A parent scolded you harshly

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi makes a mistake and a parent reacts angrily.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel loved and safe again.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The parent's anger makes Kavi feel ashamed.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi begins to confuse being corrected with being unloved.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi hears the sharp voice and looks down at the floor. The mistake was small, but the feeling in Kavi's chest is enormous.

situations.title: Not invited to a birthday party
situations.parentLabel: Not invited to a birthday party

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi discovers that several classmates are going to a birthday party and Kavi wasn't invited.
storySeed.immediateWant: Understand why and feel included.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The party invitation has already been decided.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi starts turning one missing invitation into a judgment about their worth.
context: school or a conversation among classmates
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi hears everyone talking about Saturday's birthday party. Then comes the realization: everyone is going—except Kavi.

situations.title: Falling and deciding whether to try again
situations.parentLabel: Fell down and has to decide whether to try again

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi falls during play and has to decide whether to get back up or stop because they are afraid of being hurt again.
storySeed.immediateWant: Stop the pain and feel safe again.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The body needs time and care to recover, and fear of falling again is real.
storySeed.emotionalTension: The shock makes Kavi wonder whether trying again is worth the risk.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: One second Kavi is racing along. The next, Kavi is sitting on the ground with a scraped knee, deciding whether to get back up.
storySeed.note: REVISED per locked decision — now includes the get-back-up choice, giving the seed multiple event chains.

situations.title: Missing a parent who travels often
situations.parentLabel: Missing a parent who travels a lot

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi's parent travels frequently for work, and Kavi misses them between trips.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel close to the parent even when they're away.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The parent cannot be physically present.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Distance makes Kavi wonder whether being apart means being less loved.
context: home during a parent's work trip
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi knows Mama will come back. Still, the empty chair at dinner seems to get louder every evening.

situations.title: Close friend moved to another city
situations.parentLabel: A close friend moved away

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi's closest friend moves to another city.
storySeed.immediateWant: Keep the friendship alive.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: They can no longer meet and play every day.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi fears distance means the friendship is ending.
context: final day together or first days after the move
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The moving boxes are packed. Kavi's friend is leaving, and suddenly the walk to school will have one missing person in it.

situations.title: Moving house and leaving familiar bedroom
situations.parentLabel: Moving out of your bedroom

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi leaves a familiar bedroom and moves into a new home.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel at home again.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Everything familiar has changed.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi misses the tiny details that made the old room feel like theirs.
context: moving day or first night in new home
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi walks into the new bedroom. It has walls, a bed and a window—but none of the little things that made the old room feel like home.

situations.title: Highly anticipated movie or event cancelled
situations.parentLabel: A big event you were excited for got cancelled

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi has been excited about a special outing or event, but it is cancelled.
storySeed.immediateWant: Have the planned experience happen.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The cancellation cannot be undone.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels that all the anticipation was wasted.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi has been counting down the days. Then, just before the big day, the message arrives: cancelled.

situations.title: Seeing another child cry or suffer
situations.parentLabel: Saw another child crying

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi sees another child crying after getting hurt.
storySeed.immediateWant: Help or comfort them.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi isn't sure what would actually help.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels the other child's sadness but doesn't know whether to step closer.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: A child nearby is crying, and everyone else seems to keep playing. Kavi stops and wonders, 'Should I go over?'
storySeed.note: Retained as the child-suffering version only; the animal-suffering version lives at SIT144.

situations.title: Excluded from a group chat
situations.parentLabel: Left out of a group chat

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi discovers that classmates have a group chat that Kavi isn't part of.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel included and understand what happened.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi cannot force an invitation.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Seeing the conversation happening without them makes Kavi feel unimportant.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi's friends are laughing about messages on their phones. Kavi looks at the screen and realizes there is a conversation happening that Kavi isn't part of.

situations.title: Not chosen for a special school role
situations.parentLabel: Not picked for a special role at school

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi hoped to be chosen for a special class role but another child was selected.
storySeed.immediateWant: Be chosen or feel that the effort still mattered.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The decision has already been made.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi starts turning 'not chosen this time' into 'not good enough.'
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi had imagined standing at the front of the class. Then the teacher says someone else's name.

situations.title: Intentions were good but they got in trouble anyway
situations.parentLabel: Trying to help but getting into trouble

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi tries to help someone without being asked, and the attempt accidentally creates a problem.
storySeed.immediateWant: Explain that the intention was good and repair the mistake.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The result was still a problem, even though Kavi meant well.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wonders whether good intentions count when the outcome is wrong.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi was trying to help. Somehow, the exact opposite happened. Now Kavi has to decide whether to hide behind the good intention or take responsibility for what actually happened.

situations.title: Made a mistake in front of the class
situations.parentLabel: Made a mistake in front of the whole class

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi gives an answer in class and realizes it is wrong while everyone is listening.
storySeed.immediateWant: Make the mistake disappear and avoid embarrassment.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The mistake has already happened publicly.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi suddenly feels that everyone now thinks they aren't capable.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi raises a hand, answers confidently—and then sees the teacher's gentle shake of the head. A few faces turn toward Kavi.

situations.title: Forgot someone's name
situations.parentLabel: Forgot someone's name

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi meets someone they know but suddenly cannot remember their name.
storySeed.immediateWant: Remember the name or recover gracefully.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The name won't come.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi worries the other person will think they don't care.
context: school, family gathering or social event
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi knows this person. Kavi definitely knows this person. So why has their name completely disappeared?

situations.title: Called 'fat' or 'chubby' by a peer
situations.parentLabel: A peer made a comment about your body

storySeed.childExperience: Another child makes an unkind comment about Kavi's body.
storySeed.immediateWant: Stop feeling ashamed and know how to respond.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The comment has already landed and cannot simply be unheard.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi starts wondering whether the comment says something true about their worth.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: One careless comment makes Kavi suddenly aware of their body in a way they weren't a moment ago.
storySeed.note: Story seed addresses body-based teasing without reinforcing a specific insult label.

situations.title: New glasses and feeling 'nerdy' or 'ugly'
situations.parentLabel: Feeling self-conscious about new glasses

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi gets new glasses and feels strange seeing their own face in them.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel comfortable wearing them at school.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi feels visibly different.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi worries other children will judge how they look.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi looks in the mirror. The world is suddenly sharper—and Kavi's own face looks unfamiliar behind the new glasses.

situations.title: Getting acne or pimples (older kids)
situations.parentLabel: Worried about a new pimple

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi notices a new pimple before going to school.
storySeed.immediateWant: Hide it or stop worrying about how others will see them.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi cannot instantly change their skin.
storySeed.emotionalTension: One tiny spot suddenly feels like the biggest thing everyone will notice.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi leans toward the mirror. There it is—a tiny new spot that somehow feels enormous.

situations.title: Being shortest or tallest in the class line
situations.parentLabel: Standing out for being the shortest or tallest

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi notices they are much shorter or taller than the other children while lining up.
storySeed.immediateWant: Avoid feeling different.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Their height is visible and cannot be changed.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi interprets standing out as being less important.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi joins the class line and looks around. Somehow everyone seems to fit neatly together—except Kavi.

situations.title: Being slower at reading than others
situations.parentLabel: Slower at reading than your classmates

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is still working on a reading skill while classmates seem to finish quickly.
storySeed.immediateWant: Catch up and get it right.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi needs more time and practice.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi begins confusing learning slowly with being less intelligent.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Around Kavi, pencils are already going down. Kavi is still on the same page, staring at it and wondering why it isn't clicking yet.
storySeed.note: Hard-narrowed to reading (locked) — math is a separate, distinct difficulty experience and would have weakened the three-way branching test.

situations.title: Picked last for a team
situations.parentLabel: Picked last for a team

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi watches classmates choose teammates and is the last child left.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel wanted and useful on the team.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Everyone else has already chosen.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Being picked last feels like a public ranking.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: One name. Then another. Then another. Kavi watches the teams fill up until only one place remains.

situations.title: Their clothes aren't as 'cool' as others'
situations.parentLabel: Your clothes don't feel as 'cool' as others'

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi notices that classmates are wearing clothes or shoes that seem more fashionable than theirs.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel accepted without feeling different.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi cannot suddenly have everything the other children have.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi begins believing that having nicer things would make them more liked.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: At the school gate, Kavi notices everyone's shoes, jackets and bags. Suddenly Kavi's own clothes don't seem good enough.

situations.title: Project gets no likes or views
situations.parentLabel: Your project got no likes or views

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi shares a drawing or project with a digital audience and almost nobody reacts to it.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel that the work mattered.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The number of views or likes stays low.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi begins using other people's reactions as a measure of the work's worth.
context: sharing age-appropriate creative work online or with a digital audience
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi checks the screen. Three views. No new comments. Kavi looks at the project again and suddenly wonders whether it was worth making at all.
storySeed.note: Sensitive digital-validation situation — the story should challenge the premise that likes/views measure worth, not normalize it.

situations.title: Drawing doesn't look how they imagined
situations.parentLabel: A drawing didn't turn out how you imagined

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi draws something they imagined beautifully, but the picture on paper looks very different.
storySeed.immediateWant: Make the drawing look right.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Skill hasn't caught up with imagination yet.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wants to crumple the page rather than keep trying.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: In Kavi's head, the picture was perfect. On paper, the dragon looks…well, completely different.

situations.title: Reprimanded in front of friends or guests
situations.parentLabel: Corrected in front of friends or guests

storySeed.childExperience: A parent or teacher corrects Kavi sharply while friends or guests are watching.
storySeed.immediateWant: Disappear from everyone's attention.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The embarrassing moment is happening publicly.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels that being corrected has made them smaller in everyone's eyes.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi makes a small mistake. The correction comes quickly—and so does the uncomfortable feeling of everyone watching.

situations.title: Forgot lines in a play
situations.parentLabel: Forgot your lines in a play

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is performing on stage and suddenly forgets the next line.
storySeed.immediateWant: Remember what comes next and keep the performance going.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The words have disappeared at exactly the wrong moment.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels as though the whole audience is waiting for them to fail.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi knows the next line. Kavi knows they know it. But when the moment arrives, the words vanish.

situations.title: Told their work is 'messy' or unreadable
situations.parentLabel: Told your work looked messy

storySeed.childExperience: A teacher or adult looks at Kavi's work and says it is messy or difficult to read.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel capable and have the work taken seriously.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The work really is untidy and needs improvement.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi hears feedback as proof that they aren't good enough.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi looks proudly at the finished page. Then the comment comes: 'It's very messy.' The pride disappears quickly.

situations.title: Why can't you be more like [cousin/friend]?
situations.parentLabel: Compared to a cousin or friend

storySeed.childExperience: An adult tells Kavi they should be more like a cousin or friend.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel accepted as themselves.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The comparison makes Kavi focus on everything they think they lack.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi starts believing someone else's strengths are proof of their own weakness.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: 'Why can't you be more like…' The sentence lands heavily. Kavi suddenly sees the other child as a measuring stick.
storySeed.note: [cousin/friend] is a structured relationship variable, not literal story text.

situations.title: Best friend is playing with someone else
situations.parentLabel: Your best friend is playing with someone else

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi arrives at the playground expecting to play with their best friend, but finds the friend already deep in a game with another child.
storySeed.immediateWant: Join the game and get their friend's attention.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The game is already underway and Kavi doesn't know whether there is room for them.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi starts wondering whether their friend would rather play with someone else.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi spots their best friend near the climbing frame. They hurry over—then slow down when they see who is already playing beside them.
storySeed.note: Distinct engine from SIT042 (missing connection/disappointment) — this is replacement/exclusion/jealousy.

situations.title: Friend got a new toy
situations.parentLabel: A friend got a new toy

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi sees a friend bring a brand-new toy to school, and everyone gathers around to see it.
storySeed.immediateWant: Have the toy or feel just as excited about what Kavi has.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The new toy belongs to the friend.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi suddenly compares their own favourite things with what someone else has.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The new toy comes out of the box, and everyone leans closer. Kavi looks at their own toy in their bag and suddenly it doesn't seem nearly as special.

situations.title: Classmate won Student of the Month
situations.parentLabel: A classmate won an award you wanted

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi has been working hard at school and hopes to be recognised, but another classmate receives the award.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel proud of their own effort even though they were not chosen.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The recognition has gone to someone else.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi starts turning one missed award into a judgement about their ability.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The teacher announces the winner. Applause fills the room, and Kavi claps too—but the smile feels harder to find than expected.

situations.title: Someone else got to go first
situations.parentLabel: Someone else got to go first

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is waiting for their turn in a game when another child is chosen to go first.
storySeed.immediateWant: Get their turn.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Another child is ahead of Kavi.
storySeed.emotionalTension: The waiting suddenly feels unfair, even though Kavi knows everyone gets a turn.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi has been waiting beside the game, ready for their turn. Then the teacher points to someone else. Kavi takes a breath and steps back.

situations.title: Parent on work call when child wants to share something
situations.parentLabel: A parent is busy when you want to share something

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi has exciting news they have been saving to tell a parent, but the parent starts an important work call.
storySeed.immediateWant: Tell the parent what happened.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The parent cannot listen while the call is happening.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Waiting feels like being overlooked, especially because the news feels important to Kavi.
context: home during a parent's work call
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi has been holding the news inside all afternoon. Then Mama's phone rings, the laptop opens, and the words Kavi was bursting to say have to wait.

situations.title: At a party but wanting the birthday gifts
situations.parentLabel: Wanted the birthday gifts at a friend's party

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi watches a friend open one exciting birthday present after another and begins wishing the gifts were theirs.
storySeed.immediateWant: Have the same exciting presents.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The presents belong to the birthday child.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wants to be happy for the friend while feeling increasingly disappointed about what they don't have.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Another bright package is opened. Everyone cheers. Kavi cheers too—but keeps imagining what it would feel like if that package had Kavi's name on it.

situations.title: Friend is naturally better at football
situations.parentLabel: A friend is naturally better at a sport

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi plays football with a friend who is noticeably more skilled and keeps scoring.
storySeed.immediateWant: Play well and keep up with the friend.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi is struggling to control the ball while the friend seems to do it effortlessly.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi stops enjoying the game and starts measuring every mistake against the friend's success.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi kicks. The ball rolls wide. A moment later, the friend scores again. Kavi watches the ball hit the net and suddenly forgets that they came to play.

situations.title: New sibling gets all the attention and new things
situations.parentLabel: A new baby is getting all the attention

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi has something they want to show the family, but everyone is gathered around the new baby.
storySeed.immediateWant: Have someone notice Kavi too.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The baby's arrival has changed where everyone's attention is going.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels pushed into the background during a moment that is supposed to be happy for the whole family.
context: home after a new sibling arrives
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi stands beside the sofa holding a picture they made. Mama is feeding the baby. Papa is taking photographs. Kavi waits for someone to look up.

situations.title: A classmate got the teacher's excited praise
situations.parentLabel: A classmate got the teacher's praise instead

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi gives a correct answer in class, but the teacher responds with greater excitement to another child's contribution.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel noticed and valued by the teacher.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The teacher's attention has shifted to someone else.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi begins wondering whether the other child is simply better or more liked.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi knows the answer and puts up a hand. The teacher smiles at Kavi's answer, then turns to another student with an especially excited, 'That's exactly it!'

situations.title: Friend has more followers
situations.parentLabel: A friend has more followers online

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi compares their social-media account with a friend's and notices the friend has many more followers.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel as noticed and popular as the friend.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi cannot make other people follow them simply because they want them to.
storySeed.emotionalTension: A number on a screen begins to feel like a measure of how much people value Kavi.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi looks at the follower count, then at the friend's. The difference is only a number—but suddenly it feels much bigger than that.

situations.title: Friend went on a fancy international vacation
situations.parentLabel: A friend went on a fancy vacation

storySeed.childExperience: A friend returns from an exciting international holiday with stories, photographs, and souvenirs.
storySeed.immediateWant: Have an adventure that feels just as exciting.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi's own life and holiday are different.
storySeed.emotionalTension: The friend's stories make ordinary parts of Kavi's own life suddenly feel dull.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The friend spreads photographs across the desk—snow, huge buildings, a place Kavi has only seen in pictures. Kavi listens, then thinks about their own holiday.

situations.title: Wishing they had someone else's hair
situations.parentLabel: Wishing you had someone else's hair

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi notices a friend's hair and wishes their own hair looked the same.
storySeed.immediateWant: Look like the friend.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi's own hair has a different texture, shape, or appearance.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi starts seeing their own appearance through comparison instead of accepting it as their own.
context: getting ready for school or seeing classmates
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi watches the friend's hair bounce as they walk. Later, Kavi looks in the mirror and tries to make their own hair do the same thing.

situations.title: Wanting what's in a friend's lunchbox
situations.parentLabel: Wanted what was in a friend's lunchbox

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi opens their lunchbox and notices that a friend's food looks and smells much more exciting.
storySeed.immediateWant: Have the friend's food.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The food belongs to the friend.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi suddenly feels dissatisfied with the lunch they were perfectly happy to eat a few minutes earlier.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi opens their lunchbox. Then comes the smell from the next seat. Kavi looks over—and suddenly their own lunch doesn't look quite as good.

situations.title: Friend has a later bedtime
situations.parentLabel: A friend has a later bedtime

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi discovers that a friend is allowed to stay up later than Kavi.
storySeed.immediateWant: Have the same bedtime.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi's family has a different rule.
storySeed.emotionalTension: The different rule feels unfair and makes Kavi question why their family doesn't trust them with the same freedom.
context: conversation with a friend about bedtime
storySeed.narrativeSummary: 'I don't have to sleep until ten!' the friend says. Kavi thinks about the bedtime clock at home and feels a familiar unfairness rise inside.

situations.title: Wearing an older sibling's old clothes
situations.parentLabel: Wearing an older sibling's old clothes

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi wears a hand-me-down outfit from an older sibling and notices that some classmates have newer clothes.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel confident in what they are wearing.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The clothes are old and were chosen by someone else before Kavi had them.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi worries that classmates will see the clothes as proof that Kavi has less.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi pulls the jacket on and looks in the mirror. It fits perfectly. Then Kavi remembers whose jacket it used to be.

situations.title: Post-party or festival hyperactivity
situations.parentLabel: Still full of energy after a big party

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi comes home from an exciting party still full of energy when everyone else is ready to settle down.
storySeed.immediateWant: Keep playing, talking, and reliving the fun.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The party is over and it is time to slow down.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi's body is still racing even though the day has ended.
context: home after a birthday party or celebration
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The party is over. The shoes are off. The lights are low. But Kavi is still bouncing from one exciting memory to the next.

situations.title: Zoning out after too much YouTube or gaming
situations.parentLabel: Can't focus after too much screen time

storySeed.childExperience: After spending a long time gaming or watching videos, Kavi sits down to do something else but struggles to focus.
storySeed.immediateWant: Concentrate on the next activity.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi's attention feels scattered and their mind feels tired.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi cannot understand why something enjoyable has suddenly made everything else feel difficult.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi puts the tablet away and opens a book. The first page is right there. Kavi reads the same line once. Then twice. Then a third time.

situations.title: Noisy, overcrowded mall or festival environment
situations.parentLabel: A noisy, crowded mall feels like too much

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is in a crowded mall where overlapping voices, music, movement, and smells gradually become overwhelming.
storySeed.immediateWant: Find somewhere quieter.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: There is noise and movement in every direction.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi's body becomes tense and unsettled before Kavi can even explain what is wrong.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Music plays overhead. People talk on every side. A trolley rattles past. Kavi takes another step into the crowd and wishes, just for a moment, that the world had a volume button.

situations.title: Too many classes — tuition, sport, music all in one day
situations.parentLabel: Too many activities packed into one day

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi finishes school and moves straight into tuition, then another scheduled class, with little time to rest between them.
storySeed.immediateWant: Get through the rest of the day without feeling overwhelmed.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Another activity is already waiting.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi begins to feel that the entire day is filled with things to do and nowhere to simply stop.
context: busy weekday with multiple after-school activities
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The school bag is barely off Kavi's shoulder before the tuition bag appears. After tuition comes music class. Kavi looks at the clock and wonders when the day gets to belong to Kavi.

situations.title: Long wait at doctor, bank, or during travel
situations.parentLabel: A long wait with nothing to do

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi has been waiting for a long time at a doctor's office, airport, station, or other place where the next step has not started yet.
storySeed.immediateWant: Make the waiting end.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi's turn, appointment, or journey has not begun.
storySeed.emotionalTension: The longer Kavi waits, the harder it becomes to stay patient and occupied.
context: waiting room, airport, station, or during travel
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi checks the clock again. The same number is still glowing on the screen. Kavi sighs and looks around for something—anything—to make the waiting feel shorter.

situations.title: Stuck indoors on a rainy day with nothing to do
situations.parentLabel: Stuck indoors on a rainy day

storySeed.childExperience: Heavy rain keeps Kavi indoors, and the activities that usually make a rainy day fun have already lost their appeal.
storySeed.immediateWant: Find something interesting to do.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi cannot go outside and has run out of ideas.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Boredom grows until Kavi starts feeling trapped by the day.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Rain taps against the window. Kavi has finished the puzzle, built the tower, and played the game. Kavi looks at the rain again. Still raining.

situations.title: End of a long school week — brain feels full
situations.parentLabel: Your brain feels full after a long school week

storySeed.childExperience: At the end of a demanding school week, Kavi sits down to complete one more task but struggles to concentrate.
storySeed.immediateWant: Finish the task and be done.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi's mind feels tired and has trouble taking in more information.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wants to keep going but feels as though there is no room left in their head.
context: home after a long school week
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi reads the same sentence for the third time. The words haven't changed. But somehow none of them are going in.

situations.title: Cranky after a late night or bad sleep
situations.parentLabel: Cranky after a bad night's sleep

storySeed.childExperience: After sleeping badly, Kavi wakes up tired and becomes irritated by small things that normally would not bother them.
storySeed.immediateWant: Get through the day without losing their temper.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi is already tired before the day properly begins.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Ordinary frustrations suddenly feel much bigger than they should.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi's sock feels wrong. The toast breaks. Then someone asks a perfectly ordinary question—and somehow that is the final straw.

situations.title: Trying to do homework while TV is on
situations.parentLabel: Trying to do homework with the TV on

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is doing homework while an exciting programme is playing nearby.
storySeed.immediateWant: Finish the homework without missing the show.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The sounds and action from the TV keep pulling Kavi's attention away.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi keeps trying to focus, but every interesting moment makes concentrating harder.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi writes one answer. From the next room comes a burst of laughter. Kavi's pencil stops in the middle of the next sentence.

situations.title: Too many options for a toy or treat
situations.parentLabel: Too many choices for one treat

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is allowed to choose one toy or treat from several appealing options.
storySeed.immediateWant: Make the best choice.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Each option seems exciting, and Kavi can choose only one.
storySeed.emotionalTension: The more Kavi compares the choices, the more afraid they become of choosing the wrong one.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Red or blue? Big or small? Chocolate or strawberry? Kavi looks from one choice to another. What if the best one is the one Kavi doesn't pick?

situations.title: Pressure to always 'be good' and behave
situations.parentLabel: Told to 'be good' before an important event

storySeed.childExperience: Before an important family or school event, Kavi is told repeatedly not to make a mistake.
storySeed.immediateWant: Get through the event without making a mistake.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi cannot control every impulse, feeling, or small accident.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Trying so hard to behave makes Kavi increasingly worried about doing anything wrong.
context: family gathering, school event, or formal occasion
storySeed.narrativeSummary: 'Remember to be good,' Mama whispers before they walk in. Kavi nods. Suddenly even sitting still feels like a test.
storySeed.note: REVISED per locked decision — converted from a vague ongoing parenting dynamic into a specific pre-event scene.

situations.title: Waiting for a turn on the swings
situations.parentLabel: Waiting a long time for a turn on the swings

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi reaches the playground ready to use the swing, but another child is already having a turn.
storySeed.immediateWant: Get on the swing.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi has to wait.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Each extra minute makes the waiting feel more unfair.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi stands beside the empty swing next to the one in use. The other child keeps swinging. Higher. Higher. Kavi wonders how long one turn can possibly be.

situations.title: Switching from a fun activity to homework
situations.parentLabel: Had to stop playing to do homework

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is absorbed in a favourite activity when a parent suddenly says it is time to stop and start homework.
storySeed.immediateWant: Keep playing.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The activity has to end before Kavi is ready.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Stopping feels especially hard because Kavi is deeply involved in what they are doing.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi is one move away from winning when Mama calls from the doorway. 'Time to put that away.' Kavi stares at the game.

situations.title: The 'before dinner' energy crash
situations.parentLabel: Cranky and hungry before dinner

storySeed.childExperience: Near dinner time, Kavi is hungry and tired after a long day and becomes increasingly irritable while waiting for food.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel better immediately.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Dinner is not ready yet.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Hunger and tiredness make ordinary frustrations feel much bigger.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi's stomach growls. The kitchen smells wonderful, but dinner isn't ready. Suddenly even waiting feels impossible.

situations.title: Uncomfortable uniform, flickering lights, strong smells
situations.parentLabel: Distracted by an uncomfortable classroom

storySeed.childExperience: During class, Kavi is distracted by an uncomfortable uniform, flickering light, strong smell, or another persistent sensory irritation.
storySeed.immediateWant: Make the uncomfortable sensation stop.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The irritation continues while Kavi is expected to stay focused.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Something small that others barely notice becomes impossible for Kavi to ignore.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The collar scratches again. The light flickers. Kavi tries to listen to the teacher, but the little discomforts keep demanding attention.

situations.title: Waiting very excitedly for birthday or special package
situations.parentLabel: Waiting for something exciting to happen

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is eagerly waiting for something special that is due to arrive or happen on a particular day.
storySeed.immediateWant: Make the special moment arrive sooner.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi cannot make time move faster.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Excitement makes every hour of waiting feel unusually long.
context: home before a birthday or expected delivery
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi checks the window. Nothing. Checks the calendar. Still tomorrow. Somehow one ordinary day has become the longest day ever.

situations.title: Trying to learn a very hard new concept
situations.parentLabel: Struggling to learn a hard new topic

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is learning something new that feels much harder than expected, while other children seem to understand it more quickly.
storySeed.immediateWant: Understand it and keep up.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The concept still does not make sense to Kavi.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Confusion begins turning into the fear that Kavi simply cannot learn it.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi looks at the problem again. Everyone else seems to know where to begin. Kavi's pencil stays still.

situations.title: Moving to a new home or city
situations.parentLabel: Moving to a new home

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is preparing to leave a familiar home and move to a new place.
storySeed.immediateWant: Hold on to the familiar parts of home.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The move means leaving behind familiar rooms, places, routines, or people.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels excited about what is coming but sad about what is being left behind.
context: days before or during a family move
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi walks through the nearly empty bedroom one last time. The walls are the same, but without the furniture the room already feels different.

situations.title: Moving abroad (very relevant for NRI families)
situations.parentLabel: Moving to a new country

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi learns that the family is moving to another country, far from the places and people Kavi knows.
storySeed.immediateWant: Hold on to home and familiar connections.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The distance means many familiar things will change.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Excitement about a new country sits beside worry about leaving life behind.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The suitcase lies open on the floor. Kavi folds a favourite shirt inside and wonders how far away 'home' can travel.

situations.title: Parents separating or getting a divorce
situations.parentLabel: Parents separating

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi learns that their parents will no longer live together.
storySeed.immediateWant: Understand what will happen and know that they will still be loved and cared for.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The family routine is changing in a way Kavi cannot control.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi worries that a change between the parents might also change the family bond.
context: home, after learning about the separation
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Mama and Papa are speaking quietly. Kavi hears that things will be different and suddenly wants to know one thing: what will stay the same?

situations.title: A parent starts a new job with different hours
situations.parentLabel: A parent's new work schedule means less time together

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi learns that a parent's new work schedule will change when they are home.
storySeed.immediateWant: Keep the familiar time they spend together.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The new work hours change the old family routine.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi worries that less time together might mean becoming less important.
context: home after a parent changes jobs
storySeed.narrativeSummary: 'I won't be home before dinner on Tuesdays,' Papa says. Kavi looks at the calendar. Tuesday suddenly looks very different.

situations.title: Starting at a completely new school
situations.parentLabel: Starting at a brand new school

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi begins at a school where the teachers, children, classrooms, and routines are all unfamiliar.
storySeed.immediateWant: Find their way around and find someone to belong with.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi does not yet know the people or routines.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Ordinary things—where to sit, whom to ask, where to go—suddenly feel like things Kavi could get wrong.
context: first day at a completely new school
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi stands outside the classroom door. Everyone else seems to know where to go. Kavi looks down at the timetable and takes a breath.
storySeed.note: Retained over SIT037 (dedup) as the stronger, more developed version.

situations.title: Favourite teacher changes mid-year
situations.parentLabel: Your favourite teacher is leaving

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi learns that a favourite teacher will leave and be replaced by someone new.
storySeed.immediateWant: Keep the classroom the way it is.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The teacher is leaving and Kavi cannot change that.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi worries that the new teacher will not understand them in the same way.
context: school during a mid-year teacher change
storySeed.narrativeSummary: 'There will be a new teacher next week,' the teacher says. Kavi looks around the familiar classroom and suddenly notices all the things that will be different.

situations.title: Sudden cancellation of a normal routine event
situations.parentLabel: A regular activity was suddenly cancelled

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi has been looking forward to a familiar weekly activity, but learns shortly before it begins that it has been cancelled.
storySeed.immediateWant: Have the activity happen as planned.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The activity is no longer happening that day.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels disappointed and unsettled because something familiar has suddenly changed.
context: home, school, or a regular weekly activity
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi has already packed the bag and put on the right shoes. Then Mama says, 'The class is cancelled today.' Kavi looks down at the shoes. They suddenly feel like the wrong shoes for the day.

situations.title: Summer ending and school starting again
situations.parentLabel: Summer ending and school starting again

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is enjoying the final days of summer vacation and knows school starts again in a few days.
storySeed.immediateWant: Keep the carefree feeling of the holidays going.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The holiday is ending and the school routine is returning.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi starts treating the end of summer as though the fun itself is disappearing.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi squeezes the last drops of mango juice from the glass and looks at the calendar. School starts on Monday. Somehow Monday feels much too close.
storySeed.note: Retained over SIT058 (dedup) — stronger version, naturally supports transition/anticipation/resistance/preparation/discovery.

situations.title: Noticing a new change in their body
situations.parentLabel: Noticing a change in your body

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi notices a new physical change in their body that they did not expect.
storySeed.immediateWant: Understand what is happening and know that they are okay.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The change is unfamiliar and Kavi does not yet understand it.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Something happening inside Kavi's own body suddenly feels strange and unsettling.
context: at home, e.g. brushing teeth, getting dressed, bedtime
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi notices something different and pauses. It wasn't there before. Kavi looks again, wondering what is happening.
storySeed.note: Original bundle (tooth loss + growing pains + puberty) deliberately un-bundled. Needs age-routing at generation time — do not treat puberty as generic 5-12 content.

situations.title: Friend suddenly acting different or 'cooler'
situations.parentLabel: A friend is suddenly acting different

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi notices that a close friend has started talking, behaving, or dressing differently around other children.
storySeed.immediateWant: Keep the friendship feeling the way it used to.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi cannot control how the friend chooses to change.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wonders whether becoming different means the friend is becoming distant.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Yesterday, Kavi's friend laughed at the same silly joke. Today, the friend rolls their eyes and uses words Kavi has never heard them say before.

situations.title: Game or app changes interface completely
situations.parentLabel: A favourite app or game suddenly looks different

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi opens a favourite game or app and discovers that its layout has completely changed after an update.
storySeed.immediateWant: Find the familiar controls and start playing.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The buttons, menus, and paths Kavi knows are no longer where they used to be.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Something familiar suddenly feels confusing and unfamiliar.
context: at home while using a familiar game or app
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi taps the usual button. Nothing happens. Kavi looks again. The screen seems to have rearranged itself overnight.

situations.title: New nanny or household helper joins family
situations.parentLabel: A new helper joined the family

storySeed.childExperience: A new nanny or household helper begins working at home, and Kavi is unsure about having an unfamiliar person in their everyday space.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel comfortable and safe around the new person.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi does not know them yet.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wants to be welcoming but is not ready to trust someone simply because the adults do.
context: home during the first days with the new helper
storySeed.narrativeSummary: There is a new voice in the kitchen and a new pair of shoes by the door. Kavi watches quietly, wondering where this new person fits into the family's world.

situations.title: News of an upcoming surgery or treatment
situations.parentLabel: Hearing about an upcoming medical procedure

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi learns that they or someone close to them will need a medical procedure soon.
storySeed.immediateWant: Understand what will happen and feel safe.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The procedure has not happened yet, and much of it is unfamiliar.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi's imagination starts filling in the parts they do not understand.
context: home or after a conversation with a doctor
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi hears the name of the procedure and quietly repeats the unfamiliar word. It is only a word—but Kavi's mind has already started wondering what it means.

situations.title: Family having to cut back on treats or outings
situations.parentLabel: The family is cutting back on treats for a while

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi asks for a usual treat or outing and learns that the family needs to spend less money for a while.
storySeed.immediateWant: Have the familiar treat or outing anyway.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The family has a temporary financial limit.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels the disappointment of a small 'no' without fully understanding the bigger reason behind it.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: 'Can we get the usual Friday treat?' Kavi asks. Papa smiles apologetically. 'Not this week, beta. We're being a little careful right now.'

situations.title: Waiting anxiously for exam results
situations.parentLabel: Waiting anxiously for exam results

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi has finished an important exam and now has to wait several days before the result is released.
storySeed.immediateWant: Know the result now.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The result is not available yet.
storySeed.emotionalTension: The longer Kavi waits, the more the unknown number starts to feel like a judgement about Kavi.
context: days between an exam and results day
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi checks the school portal again. Nothing. Three more days until results. Somehow a number that doesn't even exist yet is already taking up so much space in Kavi's head.

situations.title: First time staying overnight away from home
situations.parentLabel: Staying overnight away from home for the first time

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is staying overnight somewhere without their parents for the first time.
storySeed.immediateWant: Enjoy the adventure and feel comfortable enough to stay.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Everything feels different once bedtime gets close.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Excitement slowly gives way to missing the familiar sounds and routines of home.
context: first sleepover with a trusted friend or relative
